warnings: Targets follow the uploaded Excel and custom points formula, not an official Dream11 export.
Recorded participants are used for this retrospective comparison; a full pre-toss squad is not available.
Roles in the workbook are largely 2025 profile candidates, not verified historical fantasy roles.
History uses earlier completed matches, including earlier post-cutoff results as input; fitting stays within the cutoff.
3 unknown-role players excluded. Both optimizations use the same known-role subset.
Selection retains the ZIP's constraints: 11 players, 1–8 per role, at least one from each team. Credits and captain/vice-captain multipliers are not supplied.
